review_flags_scope: A stronger actual event certificate linking the same fine-cell occurrence, control, central tuple, continuous germ, global and local parameterizations, nonzero time derivative and ambient smooth graph. Partial external prototype only.
reason: The prototype faithfully closes the previously identified event-attachment interface gap. Its transparent TimedEventCertificate records the actual fine index and membership, centrality, strict local-time interior, selected control zero at the actual global path point, and the exact identities between that point, the germ centre and the actual central-leg assignment. It retains both full-parameter curve identities: the germ is the actual rescaled leg, and it is the actual global path at t+s throughout its genuine positive-radius interval. The same stored control and same moving coordinate appear in the evaluated nonzero slope, exact nonzero global-time derivative, smooth root graph, exhaustive graph equation and actual centre membership in the open slope domain. Every other named control is proved nonzero at that same centre. The constructor derives these data from actual nongenericness and the one existing set of JointLegConditions; no event index, root name, root equation, transversality or graph membership is supplied as an extra premise. The independent raw-source example constructs one actual approximation from continuity, Regular membership, Generic endpoints and delta>0, then proves that every actual nongeneric time has this certificate. Two further examples use only the certificate fields, without unfolding its constructor, to prove that the returned germ centre belongs to its returned control graph and that the actual shifted path equals the precise affine expression used by the derivative. All three new declarations and examples independently kernel-check with standard axioms only; the frozen predecessor implementations remain unchanged. This is a faithful bounded attachment result, not a completed original theorem: the named-wall classification, no-cusp conclusion and final source assembly remain unaccepted.

mathematical_justification.assessment: indexedCentralLeg is only an abbreviation for the already proved actual centralLeg indexed by the retained coarse quotient, its proof of strict centrality and the retained coordinate remainder. The certificate keeps the fine index in Fin(d.count*(2*n)), membership of the actual global time in that fine cell, and local time in (0,1). The constructor first uses actual closed-cell exhaustion, then derives centrality and strict interior from actual nongenericness, Generic collar cells and endpoint-control exclusions. It does not assume or choose an unrelated event location or moving coordinate. The same W remains the common waypoint assignment used by A and all the actual central legs.

mathematical_justification.clause: Selected actual root and all centre identities
mathematical_justification.assessment: The actual control-root set supplies a concrete name and its evaluation zero on the actual leg. The root field transports this zero to scalarCoordinates(A.path t) using the exact central-branch identity. The scaled patch germ has the actual leg centre, which yields germ_center=germ.center=A.path t and central_center=scalarCoordinates(germ.center)=leg.assignment W(localTime). Thus later consumers see the precise occurrence/name/point correspondence in the type, rather than having to reopen a hidden existence proof. The germ itself retains a nongeneric centre by the WallGerm definition.

curve_on_leg is the defining equality for every germ parameter s with the exact affine expression leg.assignment W(localTime+fineCount*s.val). curve_on_path is proved on the same whole germ interval: scaled patch bounds keep local time in (0,1), the shift lemma gives a genuine unit-interval value t+s, the actual local-time equation returns that value to the same fine cell, and its central-branch identity gives g.curve(s)=A.path(t+s). Both identities remain explicit certificate fields. The independent field-only example combines them with scalar-coordinate reconstruction to identify the actual shifted global path with the exact expression appearing in the derivative field. This avoids a mismatch between the returned index and a separately obtained germ.

mathematical_justification.clause: Unique vanishing control at the actual centre
mathematical_justification.assessment: other_controls quantifies every named control other than the selected one and proves its actual central evaluation nonzero. The constructor obtains the stronger patch product at the centre, where the product is the square of that same evaluation, and excludes zero. With the root field and germ_center equality, the recorded selected name is the only vanishing named control at the actual event centre. The field itself records central nonvanishing, not positive products for every parameter of the whole germ radius. The existing patch construction has those stronger products, but any later consumer requiring them through the certificate type must derive or expose that additional field. The current source classification interface needs the explicit central control information and actual sign-change condition.

mathematical_justification.clause: Same control and coordinate for slope, derivative and graph
mathematical_justification.assessment: The nonzero_slope field evaluates the actual coordinateSlope polynomial of the stored control at fixedAssignment of exactly indexedCentralLeg. It is derived by converting the patch root to a parameter root, proving actual coordinate dependence and applying the same JointLegConditions. The derivative field is the exact HasDerivAt of the stored leg/control expression in actual global time; its value is that control’s actual parameterSlope multiplied by d.count*(2*n). Nonzero parameter slope follows from the proved root/dependency argument and nonzero scalar step, and the natural fine-count factor is positive. No supplied gradient, alternate coordinate, unrelated nonzero scalar or opaque transversality predicate enters the type.

mathematical_justification.clause: Same actual centre in the concrete ambient smooth graph
mathematical_justification.assessment: smooth_graph is the proved C-infinity root function for the stored control and moving coordinate on their actual coordinateSlopeDomain. graph_identity gives the full actual ambient zero equation for every scalar assignment whose remaining coordinates lie in that domain. point_graph_domain puts the projected scalarCoordinates of the returned germ centre in that same domain. Its proof uses central_center and the exact assignment_other identity to identify the projection with the leg fixed assignment, then the already derived evaluated nonzero slope. The global open-domain, injective smooth graph, smooth inverse projection and zero-set/image theorems apply directly to this same name and coordinate. The independent field-only graph-membership example uses point_graph_domain, germ_center and root to place the returned actual centre in the exact graph image without inspecting the constructor. This supplies the concrete ambient smooth-hypersurface attachment intended by the prior reviewed graph characterization.

mathematical_justification.clause: Source domain and raw-source independent specialization
mathematical_justification.assessment: The constructor has n>=3, an actual approximation A for W, the actual common JointLegConditions and an actual nongeneric time. The independent raw-source example obtains d, one W and A from a continuous labelled-tuple curve with pointwise Regular membership, Generic endpoints and delta>0; NeZero is derived from n>=3. It retains continuity, exact labelled endpoints, Regular membership, same-time actual Euclidean error bound, vertex injectivity and finiteness of actual nongeneric times, then gives a certificate at EVERY such time. No root name, cell, root equation, strict interior position, graph domain or derivative proof is added to the source assumptions. Fixed occurrence labels remain unchanged throughout all actual tuple/scalar identities.

mathematical_justification.clause: Bounded completion and remaining source mathematics
mathematical_justification.assessment: This result provides an explicit type-level attachment of the already proved actual global event, curve, algebraic control and ambient graph. It does not classify the single point-triple or concurrence zero into the disjoint F/V-bigon/V-sliding/T/E/C cases, prove that no cusp occurs, or assemble the final original thm:relgp. Those obligations remain real mathematics and cannot be counted as complete because this certificate has a successful kernel check. The source-facing smooth-hypersurface meaning is the independently reviewed explicit open smooth-graph characterization; no separate manifold API is required for that concrete meaning.
